$comment: Source of truth for agent-knowledge coverage. knowledge-coverage.test.js reconciles the LIVE webjs check RULES against the docs site. A new check rule that is neither explained on a docs page nor exempted here FAILS CI. Explained = the rule name appears in a page under website/app/(site)/docs/ (the troubleshooting page is the symptom-keyed home for one). See framework-dev.md.

checkRulesExempt.components-have-register: basic setup requirement (call Class.register('tag')); framework invariant 3, not a distinctive error signature
checkRulesExempt.tag-name-has-hyphen: HTML-spec basic; framework invariant 3, no muscle-memory divergence to counter
checkRulesExempt.no-duplicate-tag: two components claim one tag name, a build-time collision surfaced by the check, not a runtime error signature
checkRulesExempt.array-prop-uses-array-type: shape hint (declare an array prop with Array not Object); the rule's own message carries the fix
checkRulesExempt.no-redirect-in-api-route: explained only in the deleted agent skill; the rule message carries the fix (return Response.redirect). Slated for removal in this PR when route handlers gain Next redirect semantics, which makes this exemption stale on purpose.
checkRulesExempt.no-interpolation-in-raw-text-element: explained only in the deleted agent skill; the rule message carries the fix (static styles or Tailwind). Remove this exemption once the troubleshooting page names the rule.
